PT
LadyBug é uma série de pinturas criada a partir de um desafio proposto por uma empresa de tintas para pintura em tela. A proposta era produzir 12 pinturas a óleo, no formato de 15 × 18 cm, sobre qualquer suporte.
As obras desta série foram pintadas sobre madeira, com exceção da primeira imagem apresentada, que foi realizada sobre tela e fez parte de outro desafio.

EN
LadyBug is a series of paintings created in response to a challenge set by an artists’ paint company. The challenge was to produce 12 oil paintings, each measuring 15 × 18 cm, on any support.
The works in this series were painted on wood, except for the first image shown, which was painted on canvas as part of a different challenge.

entry.title: temet - character design & visual development
entry.summary:
Temet is an animated series project developed through character design and visual development, with a mysterious, gothic atmosphere at its core.
For this project, I worked on the development of the main cast, exploring silhouettes, proportions, expressions, gestures and colour to define distinct personalities and establish a cohesive visual language.
The designs are built around the darker and more mysterious side of the world of Temet, balancing gothic influences with expressive, character-driven design and a visual language suited to animation.
The project includes character lineups, gesture and expression studies, and colour development.
